## Local Landscaping in Southampton and Nearby Towns

We're a family run landscaper in Southampton, covering gardens of every shape and size across the city and the towns nearby.

Two neighbourhoods that keep us busy are Bassett Heath and Old Woolston. In Bassett Heath, the plots along roads like Saxholm Way and Pinehurst Road are long, often around a quarter of an acre. That scale means garden layout and tree root management play a much bigger role than in a compact terraced street. Old Woolston is hilly, with streets rising away from the Itchen. The gardens on parts of Oak and Obelisk roads include mature lime, oak and beech. Level changes, retaining features and careful boundary work matter alongside the planting on those plots.

For regular upkeep, our [gardener](/gardener/) and [lawn care service](/lawn-care-service/) cover mowing, hedge trimming, weed control and seeding. Bigger projects go through our [landscape gardener](/landscape-gardener/) team, who handle driveways, new lawns, paving and walling, garden steps and full garden makeovers. Where the design comes first, our [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) service covers garden design, drainage and design and build projects. We also carry out tree work through our [tree service](/tree-service/) for pruning, removal and stump grinding.

A concern we hear often is that a price will grow once the job starts. We quote every job in full before we start, and what we agree is what you pay. Being family run means Test Owner stays involved throughout, so there's always one person to talk to if anything needs adjusting.

We work across Southampton and into [landscaping in Romsey](/locations/romsey/), [landscaping in Winchester](/locations/winchester/) and [landscaping in Eastleigh](/locations/eastleigh/), and everywhere in between. Call 023 0000 0000 to talk through what your garden needs.

## Your Landscaping Questions Answered

### How much does landscaping cost in Southampton?

Landscaping costs vary with garden size, ground conditions and what the job involves. A flat, clear plot is a different job to a sloping Woolston garden with mature trees and level changes to manage. Quotes are free, so a site visit is the right starting point for a proper figure.

### Are you insured?

Yes. We're covered up to £5m in public liability insurance. That cover is active throughout the job. If a branch comes down during tree pruning and catches a nearby structure, there's an insurance process to deal with it. The cover also extends to accidental injury to others while work is in progress.

### What happens if something isn't right after the job?

Call us and tell us what the issue is. Every trade in the UK works to a standard of reasonable care and skill. That means the job should be done properly and to a standard that holds up. If something doesn't meet that standard, raise it with us directly. We'd always sooner know and have the chance to make it right than leave a customer unhappy.

### How soon can you start?

We can usually start within the same week. That applies to every job, whether it's a single day's work or the beginning of something larger. Call us on 023 0000 0000 or send a message. We'll let you know what's available once we've talked through what you need.

### Is the quote free and no obligation?

Yes, the quote is free and there's no obligation to go ahead. You'll see the price for every element of the job before anything is agreed, and you're under no pressure to commit on the day.

### Which areas do you cover?

Yes, we cover Southampton and travel up to 20 miles inland and along the coast. Towns and villages in our area include [Romsey](/locations/romsey/), [Winchester](/locations/winchester/), [Eastleigh](/locations/eastleigh/), [Chandlers Ford](/locations/chandlers-ford/), [Hedge End](/locations/hedge-end/), [Lyndhurst](/locations/lyndhurst/), [Stockbridge](/locations/stockbridge/), [Lockerley](/locations/lockerley/), [Awbridge](/locations/awbridge/), [Chilworth](/locations/chilworth/), [Ampfield](/locations/ampfield/) and [Kings Worthy](/locations/kings-worthy/). Not sure if you're in range? Call 023 0000 0000 and we'll let you know.

### How long does a garden landscaping project take?

It depends on the scale and what the ground needs before other work can start. Planting or turfing finishes faster than a project combining drainage, levelling, paving and fencing. Ground preparation can add time on more slowly permeable plots. Weather can also move hard landscaping days. We'll give you a realistic timeframe when we quote.

### Why does water sit on my patio or lawn after rain?

A soggy lawn usually has one of three causes. The ground beneath may drain too slowly to absorb what falls on it. The surface may fall the wrong way, pooling water rather than shedding it. Or there's nowhere for the water to go once it's there. Southampton's geology varies across the city. Ground in the north is often more slowly permeable. Near the rivers and reclaimed land, groundwater can stay high through the wetter months. Drainage work or regrading through our [landscape designer](/landscape-designer/) service can address all three causes.
